generations.text: Tomas Sato contacted support because the Aero 2 shows a blank screen on boot since 2026-01-19. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Working. The case was escalated to tier 2 on 2026-02-01. The customer confirmed order ORD-15537 and asked for a callback. The knowledge base notes that Aero 2 firmware 3.2 fixes the charging fault on the dock. The tone of the thread is polite but increasingly impatient.
